selector.rationale: The presence of osteolytic lesions and scalp lesions with positive CD1A staining supports Multisystem Langerhans cell histiocytosis, which is a more specific diagnosis given the multisystem involvement.

rejected.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
rejected.why: Less specific than Multisystem Langerhans cell histiocytosis given the presence of osteolytic lesions and other systemic findings.

support_spans: A 4-year-old boy presented with a 3-year history of nonhealing crusted scalp lesions
Multiple disseminated erythematous papules, petechial hemorrhages, and yellowish crusts were present on the scalp
Subepidermal infiltrate consisting of large cells with kidney-shaped nuclei, solitary lymphocytes, and eosinophilic granulocytes
The infiltrate stained positively for CD1A
